entry.title: Coarse-Graining and Causal Emergence in Multi-Scale Markov Blankets. When does a macroscopic state variable possess greater causal predictive power than the underlying micro-dynamics?
entry.summary:
When does a macroscopic state variable possess greater causal predictive power than the underlying micro-dynamics? Using interventional information theory and renormalization group flows over hierarchical Markov blankets, we derive an exact threshold where macro-scale effective information $EI(M) > EI(\mu)$ due to degenerate micro-noise cancellation.

Source: Santa Fe Institute / arXiv cs.GT · Tags: #complex-systems #philosophy-of-science #cognitive-science

entry.title: Imprecise Probabilities, Dutch-Book Coherence, and Epistemic Humility Under Severe Model Misspecification
entry.summary:
Classical Bayesian conditioning collapses when an agent's prior support excludes the true data-generating process, leading to overconfident convergence on false boundary hypotheses. We prove a representation theorem for convex credal sets under $\alpha$-divergence updates that preserves dynamic coherence while guaranteeing asymptotic detection of structural misspecification.

Source: PhilSci-Archive / Formal Epistemology · Tags: #epistemology #decision-theory #philosophy-of-science
